name: K-pop Galaxy Tour
description: The world-sensation aespa is in town! Get ready for an unforgettable night of dynamic electronic dance music and stunning holographic visuals.

name: Jazz Under the Stars
description: Grammy-winning trumpeter Marcus Cole leads a quartet through classic Coltrane, Miles Davis, and original compositions beneath an open sky.

name: Electronic Beats Festival
description: Three stages, twelve DJs, and a laser show that runs all night. Top acts from Berlin's underground scene headline this pulse-pounding electronic showcase.

name: Classical Gala Evening
description: The City Philharmonic performs Beethoven's 9th Symphony and Rachmaninoff's Piano Concerto No. 2 in a breathtaking candlelit hall.

name: Folk & Roots Gathering
description: Celebrate the roots of acoustic music with storytelling songwriters from across the globe, sharing ballads, blues, and bluegrass on an intimate outdoor stage.

name: World Street Food Carnival
description: Over 80 vendors from 30 countries bring their signature dishes to one sprawling open-air market — from Taiwanese scallion pancakes to Peruvian ceviche.

name: Wine & Cheese Masterclass
description: A Michelin-starred sommelier guides guests through rare bottles paired with artisan cheeses, revealing the science and art behind perfect flavor harmony.

name: Ramen Showdown
description: Ten ramen chefs compete head-to-head for the title of best bowl in the city. Guests vote, judges deliberate, and everyone leaves full.

name: Farm-to-Table Harvest Dinner
description: Held on an actual working farm, this five-course dinner uses ingredients harvested that very morning, prepared by a rotating cast of local chefs.

name: Ancient Civilizations Exhibition
description: A stunning collection of artefacts on loan from the British Museum and the Louvre traces humanity's earliest cities — from Mesopotamia to the Indus Valley.

name: International Film Noir Festival
description: Five days of classic and contemporary noir from 20 countries, with director Q&As, restored 35mm screenings, and late-night double features.

name: City Half Marathon
description: 21 km through the city's most iconic neighbourhoods, with live bands at every kilometre marker and a rooftop finish-line party for all finishers.

name: Beach Volleyball Open
description: Elite beach volleyball teams from across the region compete on courts set up right on the waterfront — free entry for spectators.

name: Lantern Sky Festival
description: Thousands of hand-painted sky lanterns are released simultaneously at dusk in a breathtaking tradition that lights up the entire horizon.

name: Cherry Blossom Night Market
description: Celebrate peak bloom with a twilight market under illuminated sakura trees — traditional sake, street food, and live shamisen performances throughout.

name: Immersive Van Gogh
description: Walk inside the brushstrokes of van Gogh's masterworks as floor-to-ceiling 3D projections transform the gallery into Starry Night and Sunflowers.

name: Hamlet: Reimagined
description: A boundary-pushing director stages Shakespeare's Hamlet in a dystopian near-future, with a gender-swapped cast and an original score by an electronic composer.

name: International Stand-Up Night
description: Six comedians from six continents take the stage for a two-hour showcase of wildly different humour styles — slapstick, dark comedy, and sharp political satire.

name: Artisan Crafts & Vintage Fair
description: Over 200 stalls of handmade jewellery, vintage clothing, rare books, and bespoke homeware from independent makers across the region.

name: Organic Farmers Market
description: Every Sunday, local farmers bring fresh seasonal produce, homemade preserves, and foraged ingredients directly to city-centre buyers — no middlemen, all flavour.

name: City Botanic Gardens
description: Stroll through 30 hectares of landscaped gardens showcasing thousands of plant species from around the world, with tranquil ponds and seasonal flower displays.

name: Riverside Public Park
description: A beloved green escape along the river with walking trails, picnic lawns, playgrounds, and sweeping city skyline views. Open to all, free of charge.

name: Central Public Library
description: An architectural landmark housing over two million volumes, rare manuscript archives, free public reading rooms, and rotating art exhibitions on every floor.

name: Old Town Heritage Walk
description: Wander through cobblestone streets, centuries-old guild houses, and hidden courtyards at your own pace. Free self-guided maps available at every corner kiosk.

name: Waterfront Promenade
description: A vibrant public esplanade lined with cafés, street performers, and panoramic harbour views. Open all day and illuminated beautifully after dark.

name: Public Beach
description: A wide sandy shore with calm, clear water perfect for swimming. Free lifeguard service in summer, beach volleyball courts, and sunset views that draw evening crowds.

name: City Zoo
description: Home to over 500 species across 40 hectares of naturalistic habitats. Conservation programmes run alongside daily keeper talks and interactive children's zones.

name: National History Museum
description: Twelve galleries spanning earth sciences, human evolution, and world civilisations — anchored by a full T. rex skeleton in the soaring Great Hall.

name: City Aquarium
description: Dive into the deep via 50 living exhibits, a 10-metre ocean tunnel, shark feeding shows, and touch pools for hands-on encounters with rays and starfish.

name: Modern Art Museum
description: A world-class collection of 20th and 21st century works across painting, sculpture, photography, and digital media, housed in a striking contemporary building.

name: Science & Technology Museum
description: Hundreds of interactive exhibits covering space exploration, robotics, renewable energy, and the human body — a hands-on adventure for curious minds of all ages.

name: Historic Fortress & Battlements
description: Climb the original medieval walls for panoramic city views, explore dungeon chambers, and attend daily live re-enactments of the city's most dramatic sieges.
